statement: A single intravenous dose of EGFRvIII-directed CAR T cells trafficked to glioblastoma and was followed by loss of EGFRvIII expression in most resected tumours, with no clinical benefit observed.

measurement.assay: tumour histology and antigen expression after infusion
measurement.endpoint: CAR T trafficking and antigen expression
measurement.effect: trafficking confirmed; EGFRvIII decreased in most tumours; no clinical benefit

limitations: antigen loss inferred from post-treatment resection specimens

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
